snippet.title: CRACK THE PACK - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist CRACK THE PACK here : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4614210/Crack_the_Pack

Crack the Pack is an incremental game centered around opening card packs. The goal is to collect all 120 cards in the game, divided into 4 rarities, along with their metallic, holographic, negative, and glitchy variant, for a total of 600 cards !

Twitter : https://x.com/DoigtDeBelgique
